summary: A re-release of RFC 1067 with a changed status section. It defines a simple protocol for inspecting or altering management information on a network element from a remote location. It was replaced by RFC 1157.

eli5.summary: Network devices have settings and counters. This is a simple way to ask a device what is going on, or to tell it to change a setting, from far away.

questions: simple network management protocol original spec
